overview.Name: Universal Health Realty Income Trust
overview.Description: Universal Health Realty Income Trust, a real estate investment trust, invests in healthcare and human-service related facilities. It also includes acute care hospitals, behavioral health care hospitals, specialty facilities, medical/office buildings, free-standing emergency departments and childcare centers. They have investments in seventy-six properties located in twenty-one states. Universal Health Realty Income Trust was incorporated in 1986 and is based in King of Prussia, United States.
